source_contracts.relation: option IDs and decision dependencies must resolve exactly

claim_ceiling: This fixture proposes tests but contains no observations or selected experiment. It establishes no supplier/resource/product qualification, probabilities, outcome likelihoods, physical safety, cost, schedule, resilience improvement, ROI or operating authority.

decision_paradigm.question: What is the cheapest safe observation that could invalidate a decision-critical assumption before committing to a factory resilience option?
decision_paradigm.execution_boundary: Advisory only; documentary/simulation/physical work retains its own evidence class, qualified practitioners, safety approvals and execution authorization.

assumptions.claim: At least one alternate source can supply the required material grade, pass the applicable qualification, meet the required quantity, and arrive in a usable window after the primary-lot rejection.
assumptions.scope: the declared fabric/layer/trim BOM grades and target production horizon
assumptions.consequence_if_false: supplier redundancy does not restore accepted output; substitution or waiting blocks the affected route
assumptions.falsifier: the candidate cannot produce evidence for the exact grade/process envelope, lacks qualified available capacity, or its arrival window misses the required production window

assumptions.claim: An alternate sewing resource is capable, qualified, calibrated where required, and available to absorb the relevant workload without creating an unmodelled downstream bottleneck.
assumptions.scope: sewing operation profile for the specified topper variants and output acceptance criteria
assumptions.consequence_if_false: nominal redundancy cannot restore throughput or produce accepted articles
assumptions.falsifier: the resource fails the capability/qualification envelope, has no usable calendar capacity, or shifts the bottleneck beyond the declared service threshold

assumptions.claim: The proposed essential-utility continuity path can support every required production, inspection, metrology, restart, and calibration dependency within the declared operating envelope.
assumptions.scope: factory utilities and shared dependencies for cutting/sewing/inspection and safe restart
assumptions.consequence_if_false: backup power may keep production visible but leave acceptance inspection or recovery unavailable
assumptions.falsifier: load/dependency analysis shows shared failure mode or insufficient capacity; post-restoration checks or requalification requirements cannot be met

assumptions.claim: Qualified workers covering each required skill can be available within the actual shift/calendar constraints, without treating training or reassignment as instantaneous.
assumptions.scope: receiving, cutting, sewing, assembly, inspection, measurement, packaging and approved repair work where applicable
assumptions.consequence_if_false: equipment redundancy exists on paper but required operations remain unschedulable
assumptions.falsifier: the roster and qualification evidence show no available worker for a required operation/time window, or the proposed training path exceeds the recovery horizon

assumptions.claim: The proposed common modules and product-family commonality preserve required fit, function, quality, and acceptance across every claimed product variant while reducing actual setup or material burden.
assumptions.scope: topper sizes/configurations and any later furniture/workwear transfer only after separate admission
assumptions.consequence_if_false: shared-module savings, variant flexibility and reduced inventory are overstated or product acceptance fails
assumptions.falsifier: drawing/BOM comparison or controlled sample assembly reveals incompatible interfaces, variant-specific components, added rework, or no evidenced changeover/yield advantage

assumptions.claim: A named common replacement part is stocked or replenishable, installable with available skills/tools, and can restore the product to its required accepted service state.
assumptions.scope: one specifically identified wear component and repair acceptance profile; no general repairability claim
assumptions.consequence_if_false: modular design does not reduce downtime; repairable-by-design is mistaken for completed repair
assumptions.falsifier: part identity/interchangeability or inventory/lead-time evidence fails, repair capacity is absent, or the repaired article fails its acceptance test

assumptions.claim: The synthetic lost-accepted-unit-hour and recovery intervals are adequate only as challenge-oracle test values; using them to choose a real strategy would require a separately justified, scenario-specific model-discrepancy envelope.
assumptions.consequence_if_false: constructed test vectors are misinterpreted as predictive estimates and a real investment is selected on unsupported outcomes
assumptions.falsifier: any real-world recommendation cites the current synthetic interval bounds as measured, calibrated, probabilistic, or decision-valid physical evidence

assumptions.claim: A future delivered-cost comparison uses the same accepted function, accepted-unit denominator, currency/time basis, operating horizon, and fully declared cost categories for every alternative.
assumptions.scope: reference and candidate product/factory configurations in a future admitted cost study
assumptions.consequence_if_false: the nominally cheaper strategy appears to win because costs, yield loss, returns, capital utilization, or service differences are omitted
assumptions.falsifier: an independent cost ledger reconciliation finds mismatched units/boundaries, missing required categories, incompatible product service, or non-comparable bases

assumptions.claim: A later baseline/candidate comparison has a frozen workload and calendar, accepted-output definition, run horizon, resource/worker capabilities, and independent scorecard before outcomes are inspected.
assumptions.scope: all quantitative comparisons under MFG-VALUE-001 for this household-goods vertical
assumptions.consequence_if_false: policy comparison is confounded by easier work, changed constraints, selective case removal or post-hoc metric choice
assumptions.falsifier: the baseline and candidate use different inputs or metric definitions, the holdout is exposed to candidate selection, or exclusions cannot be reconciled

experiment_candidates.title: Audit the current supplier/grade/lead-time evidence
experiment_candidates.purpose: Check whether exact grade, qualification, capacity, quantity, lead-time window, source date and quote/offer identity exist; a vendor name or catalogue label is insufficient.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: the exact source/grade/capacity evidence satisfies the preregistered requirements for the declared window
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: at least one mandatory identity, qualification, capacity or timing condition is absent or contradicted
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: commercial confidentiality or missing records prevent a decision; preserve unknown

experiment_candidates.title: Bounded incoming material qualification
experiment_candidates.purpose: If documentary evidence is insufficient and the material owner authorizes it, inspect/test a representative sample under the required material profile before any process substitution.
controlled_variables: acceptance criteria frozen before the test
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: observations meet the frozen profile within admitted measurement uncertainty
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: observations violate the frozen material-grade acceptance rule beyond uncertainty
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: sample representativeness, calibration or method applicability is unresolved

experiment_candidates.title: Audit alternate workcell capability and availability
experiment_candidates.purpose: Resolve exact process capability, tooling/configuration, qualification, maintenance/calibration currency and calendar availability before a physical trial.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: all required capabilities, qualification and usable capacity are evidenced
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: a hard capability or availability requirement is absent/contradicted
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: source refs or resource state are missing/stale

experiment_candidates.title: Map utility and inspection common-mode dependencies
experiment_candidates.purpose: Review actual one-line/dependency diagrams and declared process, metrology, calibration and restart loads; identify whether a purported backup preserves the required full service.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: the declared topology and load envelope support every required critical process and inspection/restart dependency
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: a common-mode failure, capacity shortfall or required unavailable acceptance path remains
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: diagram, load or requalification evidence is missing
experiment_candidates.safety_authority: documentary_review_only; physical electrical tests require qualified local authorization

experiment_candidates.title: Worker-skill and shift-window audit
experiment_candidates.purpose: Check current qualification, currency, shift roster and feasible coverage for the exact tasks; represent training as elapsed time and assessed competence.
observations_to_collect: qualified staff coverage by time window
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: every required operation has a qualified worker in the needed time window
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: at least one required window has no qualified available worker
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: roster or qualification freshness is unresolved

experiment_candidates.title: Variant-BOM and reversible sample-assembly check
experiment_candidates.purpose: Compare exact BOM/drawing/interface revisions and, if approved, assemble a bounded non-production sample while recording fit/function acceptance, setup time, rework and waste.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: all claimed variants meet the frozen acceptance profile and an independently measured setup/waste benefit is observed
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: a variant fails acceptance, needs unmodelled special parts, or no benefit is observed within the stated measurement resolution
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: sample scope, operator effect or metrology uncertainty prevents interpretation

experiment_candidates.title: Common-spare identity and bounded repair acceptance test
experiment_candidates.purpose: Bind the exact spare part, interchangeability envelope, inventory/lead time, tool/skill/capacity and post-repair acceptance before claiming downtime reduction.
observations_to_collect: timed repair and consumed resources if authorized
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: the qualified spare and repair path restore the specified accepted service under the defined test conditions
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: the spare is unavailable/incompatible, repair capacity is missing, or the article fails acceptance

experiment_candidates.title: Independent cost-boundary and denominator audit
experiment_candidates.purpose: Reconcile source records, all mandatory cost categories, units, currency/date basis, accepted units, returns/warranty and capital allocation before candidate scores are compared.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: an independent evaluator confirms complete, comparable categories and the declared functional-unit basis
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: any required cost component, unit, boundary or denominator is inconsistent or absent
experiment_candidates.if_indeterminate: commercially withheld records prevent complete cost evaluation

experiment_candidates.title: Baseline and scorecard preregistration audit
experiment_candidates.purpose: Freeze baseline/candidate policy revisions, task mix, resource calendars, disruption injections, holdout, result states, exclusions, primary metric and guardrails before scoring.
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: both arms share the declared input boundary and a frozen independent evaluator can reproduce case-wise results
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: policy/input differences, holdout leakage or selective exclusions are found

experiment_candidates.title: Assumption-bound audit of synthetic interval claim limits
experiment_candidates.purpose: Ensure synthetic challenge bounds are never admitted as estimates of a real factory, and specify what data/model validation would be required before producing physical bounds.
controlled_variables: model discrepancy and physical validation requirements
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_holds: all reports retain synthetic-only semantics and physical claims remain blocked
experiment_candidates.if_assumption_fails: any synthetic value is re-labelled or used as measured, calibrated, probabilistic or predictive evidence

required_invariants: Every critical assumption has a falsifier and at least one candidate experiment.
Every option/scenario dependency resolves to the exact frozen source sets.
No candidate experiment is selected from this definition fixture.
No outcome observation, measured cost/duration, scenario probability, expected value or ROI is inferred from blank fields.
Every physical or production-affecting test remains unapproved until the applicable qualified owner authorizes it.
A changed assumption revision invalidates dependent decision receipts; historical results are preserved and not silently rewritten.
Experiment predictions, thresholds, controls and exclusion rules must be frozen before execution.
A cheapest test may be chosen only after its ability to discriminate the competing hypotheses and its safety prerequisites are established.
